coverage_exceptions.name: Icarus
coverage_exceptions.reason: Independent VECTORS table changed position discontinuously near JD 2618073.0108 (2455); keep the continuous trajectory through the preceding century boundary.

coverage_exceptions.name: Apollo
coverage_exceptions.reason: Full-span Apollo source failed the continuity gate. The independent VECTORS replacement also jumped by about 65,026 km near JD 2396400.62907. Start at the following century boundary, before the original observation arc and the 1930 encounter.

coverage_exceptions.name: Duende
coverage_exceptions.reason: Full-span Duende source failed the continuity gate. The independent VECTORS replacement jumped by about 45,570 km near JD 2625740.67. End at the preceding century boundary after validating the 2278 replacement.
